name: medintel
goal: answer AI queries about product use and maintenance patterns in sales reports
sensor: analyst question in natural language plus new sales and service reports arriving
actuator: deliver an insight report with charts, findings and recommended actions
control: only publish insights backed by at least three independent reports; flag low-confidence answers
plan: harvest reports, translate the question into queries, mine patterns, compose the insight
navigate: route between report-harvest and query-engine until the insight passes the evidence check

children.name: report-harvest
children.goal: build a clean, query-ready pool of sales and service reports
children.sensor: ERP sales orders, field-service tickets, installed-base registry, warranty claims
children.actuator: write normalized report records into the analysis store
children.control: reject duplicates and records missing machine serial, date or customer site
children.plan: pull from each source, map to one schema, link every record to a machine serial
children.navigate: sweep sources oldest-to-newest, then loop back for late-arriving service tickets

children.name: erp-connector
children.goal: extract sales and service lines from the ERP
children.sensor: Business Central API: invoices, contracts, spare-part orders
children.actuator: emit raw report rows with machine model, serial, site and dates
children.control: verify row counts against ERP totals; retry on partial pulls
children.plan: authenticate, page through new entries since last sync, tag each with source and timestamp
children.navigate: walk entity by entity: orders, then contracts, then spare parts

children.name: report-cleaner
children.goal: turn messy free-text reports into structured facts
children.sensor: raw report rows with free-text engineer notes and symptom descriptions
children.actuator: attach structured tags: failure mode, component, usage intensity, downtime hours
children.control: quarantine rows where the extracted tags contradict the numeric fields
children.plan: parse notes with the language model, map phrases to the failure-mode taxonomy
children.navigate: process per machine family so model context stays consistent

children.name: query-engine
children.goal: turn an analyst question into evidence-backed patterns
children.sensor: analyst question plus the normalized report pool
children.actuator: produce ranked pattern candidates with supporting report citations
children.control: drop patterns that vanish when one customer or one quarter is excluded
children.plan: classify the question as usage or maintenance, dispatch to the matching miner, merge results
children.navigate: route usage questions to usage-patterns, wear questions to maintenance-forecast, both when mixed

children.name: usage-patterns
children.goal: find how customers actually use the machines
children.sensor: scan counts, operating hours, consumable orders per machine serial
children.actuator: emit usage clusters: heavy 24/7 sites, weekday clinics, seasonal screening programs
children.control: require each cluster to hold at least five machines before naming it a pattern
children.plan: compare consumable order rhythm against contracted capacity to infer real utilization
children.navigate: iterate machine families, then drill from region to site to serial

children.name: maintenance-forecast
children.goal: predict which machines need service before they fail
children.sensor: failure-mode tags, part replacement intervals, downtime hours per serial
children.actuator: emit a watchlist: serial, suspected component, predicted weeks until failure
children.control: backtest every prediction rule on last year's failures; keep rules above 80% precision
children.plan: correlate usage intensity from usage-patterns with observed wear to build lifetime curves
children.navigate: ask usage-patterns for a machine's cluster before scoring its wear

children.name: insight-delivery
children.goal: hand the analyst a decision-ready answer
children.sensor: ranked patterns and watchlists from query-engine
children.actuator: publish the insight report and alert service planners about urgent watchlist machines
children.control: block publication if any cited report is quarantined or the confidence score is below threshold
children.plan: summarize patterns in plain language, attach evidence charts, propose next actions
children.navigate: order findings by business impact: safety first, then downtime cost, then upsell
